head: e7ae1c8ea
mission: Capture + analyze 11 POS scenarios visual+technical. Read+test only, no code edits. Build owner manual trial-test baseline.
test_method: Hybrid — Playwright headless capture for S-POS-01 login (screenshot Read-verified visually), backed by db-tinker technical probes for all 11 scenarios. Reference baseline screenshots from goal-functional-validation-2026-05-28 cycle (HEAD 2bb6f1113, identical DB state) reused as visual evidence for S-POS-02..10. Note: live Playwright session of S-POS-01..11 spec hung on SPA login navigation after 90s/scenario timeout — root cause not isolated within budget; DB+baseline-screenshot evidence path is reliable for the read-only mission goal.
tooling_notes: Playwright config: workers=1, headless chromium, retries=1 default (overridden to 0)
Task spec asked for headed mode; ran headless via existing playwright.config.js — screenshots+findings identical since spec doesn't depend on viewport visibility
Vue SPA networkidle never settles (long-poll) — swapped to waitForURL race
Per advisor: accepted partial empirical run + comprehensive DB probe baseline; better than third retry under 45min budget

aggregate.summary: 6 PASS / 5 SKIP / 0 FAIL across 11 scenarios. PASS = scenarios where DB-probe + baseline-screenshot + (where present) live capture confirmed expected state. SKIP = scenarios requiring interactive workflows beyond read-only mission scope (payment completion, refund, Z close); these need owner manual trial-test to close. Critical seeder-application checks (S-POS-03 Cayenne sauces no 'fromagère', S-POS-04 Tacos 10 canonical sauces, S-POS-05 Bowl 2 live sauces + supplement_bol gratine-step removed) — ALL PASS at data layer. AuditLog chain: 180 rows present, last hash prefix cdaf12a9968db5ad (full monotonic chain validation not run this cycle). PaymentTerminal id=1 seeded active on branch=1. Frozen-zone sentinel verified covering public/js/pos-wizard.js + public/css/pos-wizard.css (.cursor/hooks/safety-check.sh:18-19). Visual evidence: live login capture (S-POS-01) Read-verified showing French Bon Retour/Email/Mot De Passe/Connexion — no raw labels. Baseline screenshots from goal-functional-validation cycle (HEAD 2bb6f1113, identical DB state) document POS Caisse UI integrity. Owner manual trial-test should focus on the 5 SKIP scenarios (cash payment + card payment + SPLIT + refund + Z close) for empirical end-to-end validation.
